description:
What people on Facebook are saying about Georgia's prisons: public posts in the Ga. Prisons Exposed
    group and comments on GPS's own Facebook posts that GPS kept (families, formerly incarcerated people,
    former officers, advocates), newest first, each with its author, date, link and label:
    'first-hand or inside account' (something specific that happened, seen or lived by the author or told
    by someone inside), 'opinion', 'idea for change', or 'news retold'. Filters: q (words), facility (a
    prison name, e.g. "Telfair"), days (default 30, max 365), label (account | opinion | idea | news),
    limit (default 10, max 60). `counts` gives items and people per label for the whole match.
    These are the authors' own views and accounts, never GPS findings: attribute and link every quote.
    Names of people in custody and GDC numbers are removed before the data leaves GPS.
name: get_facebook_posts
title: Get Facebook posts
